topic: Agent tools and frameworks for real-world AI applications
audience: AI application developers at small teams who build and maintain production software with limited time for infrastructure and evaluation
central_question: Which recently released agent tools and frameworks are ready for real-world use by small teams, and what should developers test before adopting them?
scope: Focus on agent frameworks, tool calling, orchestration, evaluation, reliability, security, deployment, cost, and developer workflow. Prefer evidence from the preceding 30 days.
exclusions: Exclude generic AI announcements without a concrete implication for building or operating agent applications; do not treat demos or vendor benchmarks as proof of production readiness.
